description: Get global question counts across the entire Open Trivia Database: total questions, verified (live and servable), pending (under review), and rejected, with a per-category breakdown. Useful for understanding database coverage — typically 5000+ verified questions spread across 24 categories. Note: only verified questions are returned by opentdb.trivia.questions. Source: opentdb.com — CC BY-SA 4.0, free unlimited.

_placeholder.description: No parameters required — returns global question counts and per-category breakdown.

name: opentdb.trivia.global_count

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Open Trivia DB — Global Question Statistics
